about.title: About me
about.p1: I am a creative designer and freelance web developer, formerly based in Geneva and currently in Australia for one year. I help businesses create modern, high-performing, conversion-focused websites as well as their visual identity (logos, business cards, flyers, and digital assets).
about.p2: I am developing a particular expertise in the food and hospitality industry (restaurants, cafés, bars, caterers), a field I am passionate about where branding, visual identity, and customer experience are essential.
about.p3: Although I currently work with businesses across various industries, my goal is to increasingly support hospitality professionals by creating digital experiences that attract attention and drive reservations.
about.p4: Each project is tailor-made with a results-driven approach: attract, convince, and convert your customers through strategic design and an optimized user experience.

FAQ.question_1: How much does it cost to build a professional website?
FAQ.answer_1:
Our professional websites start at €500. The price depends on your project, the number of pages, and the features you need. Each website is designed to showcase your business, strengthen your credibility, and turn visitors into potential customers.



Have a project in mind? Contact us for a quote tailored to your needs and budget.
FAQ.question_2: How long does it take to build a website?
FAQ.answer_2:
The timeline depends on your project and the package you choose. Our Essential package can be delivered within 5 business days, while a custom website typically takes around 2 weeks. These timeframes are estimates and depend in particular on when we receive your content and on the complexity of the project.



We work with you to establish a clear timeline so you can launch your online presence under the best possible conditions.
FAQ.question_3: Will my website work on mobile phones and tablets?
FAQ.answer_3:
Yes. All our websites are designed to adapt to mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers. Responsive design allows your visitors to browse easily on any screen, with a seamless experience, a polished layout, and easy access to your information.



A mobile-friendly website improves the user experience and supports SEO best practices on Google.
FAQ.question_4: Will my website design be tailored to my business?
FAQ.answer_4:
Yes. We design a personalized website based on your business, visual identity, and target audience. The colors, layout, content, and calls to action are carefully considered to present your services clearly and professionally.



The goal is to help you stand out from your competitors, build trust from the very first visit, and make it easy for potential customers to get in touch.
FAQ.question_5: Will my website be optimized for search engines (SEO)?
FAQ.answer_5:
Yes. We incorporate SEO fundamentals from the very beginning of your website project, including a clear page structure, optimized titles, content optimization, technical performance, and mobile compatibility. Depending on your project, we can also work on local SEO to improve your visibility among customers in your area.



SEO lays a solid foundation for helping search engines better understand your website. However, results depend on many factors and cannot be guaranteed. Our goal is to help you build your online visibility over the long term.
FAQ.question_6: Can I add new features to my website as my business grows?
FAQ.answer_6:
Yes. Your website is designed to evolve alongside your business. You can consider adding new pages, forms, specific features, or automations based on your needs and the technical possibilities of your project.



Whether you want to expand your services, improve the customer journey, or simplify certain tasks, we can explore solutions that align with your goals. This gives you a foundation designed to support your growth.
FAQ.question_7: Do I have to pay a subscription for my website?
FAQ.answer_7:
No. Your website can be built without a mandatory monthly subscription for the website creation itself. Hosting is included according to the terms of your package. Starting with the Growth package, your domain name is also included free of charge for the first year. Additional fees may apply to certain third-party services or specific features.



If you would like ongoing support after launch, we offer optional maintenance plans. We explain all expected costs upfront so you can choose a solution that fits your budget.
FAQ.question_8: Will my website be secure, and can you maintain it?
FAQ.answer_8:
We follow appropriate development practices to help ensure your website's security and reliability. Depending on the technologies used, this may include HTTPS configuration, dependency checks, and form security measures. However, no website can be guaranteed to be completely risk-free.



After launch, we can also provide maintenance services tailored to your needs, including updates, bug fixes, and technical checks. This gives you access to ongoing support to help keep your website running smoothly over time.
FAQ.question_9: Are hosting and a domain name included in your package?
FAQ.answer_9:
Hosting is included according to the terms of your package. Starting with the Growth package, your domain name is included free of charge for the first year. For other packages, the domain name is an additional cost. We can take care of the configuration and launch to make the technical process easier for you.



After the first year, domain name renewal fees may apply. We explain the applicable terms before launch so you know exactly what is included in your package.
FAQ.question_10: Which tasks can you automate in my business?
FAQ.answer_10:
We build automations tailored to your business to reduce repetitive tasks and save you time. Depending on your needs and the tools you use, these may include lead management, automated notifications, customer inquiry tracking, connecting your tools, or automating specific steps in your workflows.



Every solution is assessed based on your current processes and goals. The aim is to reduce manual work, streamline your operations, and allow you to focus on growing your business.



Want to find out what could be automated in your business? Contact us to explore solutions tailored to your needs.

faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about our maintenance plans.

faq_1.question: Can I change my plan?
faq_1.answer: You can request to switch to another plan. The change will take effect according to the terms set out in your agreement.

faq_2.question: Are changes unlimited?
faq_2.answer: No. Growth includes up to 2 minor changes per month, while Premium includes up to 5. Unused changes do not roll over. Complex requests may require a separate quote.

faq_3.question: What counts as a minor change?
faq_3.answer: Examples include editing existing text, replacing a supplied image, or updating business hours. A new page, redesign, or new feature does not count as a minor change.

faq_4.question: Are hosting and the domain name included?
faq_4.answer: Hosting is included in the plans presented. The domain name, paid third-party services, and renewals must be specified in the quote or agreement.

faq_5.question: What if I need a major change?
faq_5.answer: Describe what you need, and we'll provide a separate estimate before work begins. No additional work will proceed without your approval.

purposes.title: Why do we use your data?
purposes.intro: Data is processed for the following purposes:

items.contact: to receive and respond to your contact messages;
items.quote: to understand your requirements and prepare a response or quotation;
items.followUp: to communicate with you and follow up on your enquiry;
items.contract: to take the pre-contractual steps you request and, if you accept a proposal, to prepare for or fulfil a contractual relationship;
items.security: to ensure the security, proper operation and maintenance of the website, where technical data is processed for these purposes;
items.legal: to comply with legal obligations and protect Simplitech's rights in the event of a dispute, where necessary.

purposes.outro: Data must not be reused for a purpose incompatible with the purpose for which it was collected. Any further use requiring separate information or a distinct legal basis will be subject to the appropriate measures.

legalBases.title: What are the legal bases for processing?
legalBases.intro: Depending on the processing activity concerned, data is processed on one of the following legal bases:

precontractual.label: Pre-contractual measures:
precontractual.text: when you request a quotation or wish to discuss a potential service, the necessary data is processed to respond to your request.

legitimateInterest.label: Legitimate interests:
legitimateInterest.text: certain data may be processed to respond to a general enquiry, ensure website security, prevent abuse or handle a complaint, after assessing your rights and interests.

legalObligation.label: Legal obligation:
legalObligation.text: where legislation requires certain information to be retained or disclosed.

consent.label: Consent:
consent.text: where required, particularly for certain non-essential cookies or tracking technologies, or for other uses that require your agreement.

legalBases.outro: You may refuse to provide certain information. However, if that information is necessary to respond to your enquiry or prepare a quotation, your refusal may prevent us from processing your request.

retention.title: How long do we retain your data?
retention.intro: Data is retained only for a period appropriate to its purpose, subject to applicable legal obligations.
retention.clientText: If an enquiry results in a service engagement, certain data may be retained throughout the contractual relationship and then archived for the periods required by legal, accounting or tax obligations and to establish, exercise or defend legal claims. Retention periods vary depending on the document concerned.
retention.technicalText: Retention periods depend on the hosting provider, security tools and actual configuration. They should be defined according to security requirements and applicable obligations.
retention.outro: At the end of the applicable retention period, data is deleted or anonymised unless further retention is necessary or required by law.

recipients.title: Who can access your data?
recipients.intro: Data is accessible only to those who need it for the purposes described in this policy.

company.label: Simplitech:
company.text: to process enquiries, communicate with you and manage business follow-up.

providers.label: Technical service providers:
providers.text: the providers actually used for hosting, form submission, email communications, website maintenance or security, to the extent necessary for their respective tasks.

authorities.label: Competent authorities:
authorities.text: where required by a legal obligation or an enforceable decision.

recipients.outro: The relevant service providers must be identified according to the website's actual configuration. Data is not sold to third parties.

transfers.title: Hosting and transfers outside the European Union
transfers.paragraph1: The website is hosted by Vercel. Depending on the technical configuration, the services enabled and the associated providers, certain technical data or data submitted through the website may be processed in countries outside the European Union, including the United States.
transfers.paragraph2: Where personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, the transfer must rely on a mechanism compliant with the GDPR, such as an applicable adequacy decision or appropriate contractual safeguards, depending on the transfer and the provider concerned.

rights.title: What are your rights?
rights.intro: Subject to the conditions and limitations set out in applicable regulations, you may request:

items.rectification: rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data;
items.erasure: erasure of your data where the relevant conditions are met;
items.objection: objection to processing based on legitimate interests, on grounds relating to your particular situation;
items.portability: data portability where this right applies;
items.withdrawal: withdrawal of your consent at any time where processing is based on consent, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before consent was withdrawn.

rights.contactOutro: and specify your request. Additional information may be requested where necessary to verify your identity in a proportionate manner.
rights.responseTime: A response is generally provided within one month. This period may be extended under the conditions set out in the GDPR, particularly in the case of complex or numerous requests.
rights.complaintIntro: If, after contacting us, you believe your rights have not been respected, you may lodge a complaint with the French Data Protection Authority (Commission nationale de l’informatique et des libertés, CNIL) via

security.title: Data security
security.content: Simplitech implements technical and organisational measures appropriate to its activities to protect data against loss, alteration, disclosure or unauthorised access. As no transmission or storage system can guarantee absolute security, the measures adopted are proportionate to the risks and the tools actually used.

cookies.title: Cookies and other tracking technologies
cookies.paragraph1: Cookies and other tracking technologies may be used to provide certain features, remember preferences, protect the website or measure its audience. The tools actually used must be verified before this policy is published.
cookies.paragraph2: Tracking technologies that are strictly necessary for the requested service may be subject to different rules from those applicable to non-essential tracking technologies. Where consent is required, the relevant technologies must not be placed before consent has been obtained.
cookies.paragraph3: If the website uses a consent management tool, you will be able to change your choices through the cookie management mechanism provided on the website. This mechanism must actually be installed and functional before it is described as available.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.content: This policy may be updated to reflect changes in processing activities, the tools used or applicable obligations. The date of the latest update appears at the top of this page. Where a substantial change requires specific notification, affected individuals will be informed through appropriate means.

footer.title: Questions about your personal data?
footer.text: Contact Simplitech to exercise your rights or obtain further information about how your data is processed.
